title: Character voice
description: films/<film>/characters/<id>/voice.json: how a character sounds (D-036). Chosen once at casting and used for every line the character speaks; the director never names raw voices in a line. One or more voices are blended by weight, then speed and a small pitch step are applied, and each line is normalized to a speech loudness.

engine.description: Text-to-speech model family: kokoro (voices), parler (Indic Parler-TTS: a named speaker, D-042). chatterbox only if approved at voice casting.

language.description: Language and accent of the lines. Required for parler; for kokoro it defaults to the first voice's language.

speaker.description: parler: a named speaker of the model, e.g. 'Mary' (English) or 'Divya' (Hindi).

pitch.description: parler: the speaker's pitch, asked for in the description at synthesis.

voices.description: kokoro: voices to blend, each with a weight; weights are normalized to sum to 1.

id.description: A voice of the engine, e.g. 'af_heart' (Kokoro: language/accent letter, gender letter, name).

speed.description: 1 = the voice's natural pace. parler: below 0.9 asks for a slow pace, above 1.1 a fast one.

pitch_semitones.description: Pitch step applied after synthesis (raises pitch and formants together, like a shorter vocal tract). 0 = none.

expressiveness.description: How animated the delivery is, for engines that support it (parler, chatterbox). Ignored by kokoro.

loudness_lufs.description: Integrated loudness each line is normalized to before mixing.
